11._section_summary: This discussion section details a study conducted in Iran, focusing on the factor structure and psychometric properties of the BAS-2 among a university population of men and women. The study found a one-factor structure for the Persian BAS-2, consistent with previous research. It also explored correlations between BAS-2 scores and other variables, noting a negative association with BMI in women and a positive association in men, which contradicts some prior findings. The study acknowledges limitations including the university-based sample, self-reported BMI, and lack of ethnicity data.
